college_identity.identity_notes: One of ten new NITs established in 2010 during India's 11th Five-Year Plan; initially mentored by NIT Karnataka, Surathkal. Operated for over a decade from a temporary campus at Farmagudi, Ponda (functioning out of the Goa Engineering College, GEC, campus), before moving to its permanent campus at Cuncolim, South Goa (~114-120 acres, figures vary by source), inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 6 February 2024. Explicitly verified DISTINCT from IIT Goa (a separate, newer institute established 2016, which per Wikipedia's Farmagudi article ALSO operated temporarily from the same Farmagudi/GEC location as NIT Goa did — a genuine and notable co-location risk during the temporary-campus era) and from Goa Engineering College (GEC) itself, the separate state institution that hosted both NIT Goa and IIT Goa temporarily. No evidence from IIT Goa or GEC was included in this extraction. Also note: due to the recent physical relocation (2023-2024), some reviews in this dataset describe the old Farmagudi campus and others describe the new Cuncolim campus — both are preserved with this distinction noted where identifiable.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The CSE department at NIT Goa is one of the most sought-after branches, known for its strong academic background and growing research culture. The curriculum is well structured, regularly updated to match industry trends, and includes core subjects like Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, Machine Learning, etc. Faculty members are highly qualified, many holding PhDs from reputed institutes, and are approachable for academic guidance and project work. The department promotes coding culture through active clubs and regular hackathons.'

'The CSE branch at NIT Goa has shown consistently strong placements compared to other branches. In 2024, around 86% of CSE students got placed, with an average package of approximately 10.7 LPA and highest reaching 20 LPA.'

review_items.extraction_note: This review explicitly describes the OLD Farmagudi temporary campus era, prior to the 2024 Cuncolim relocation.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'NIT Goa offers a developing yet efficient infrastructure that supports academic and student life adequately. Currently functioning from its temporary campus in Farmagudi, the institute provides well-maintained classrooms, equipped with modern teaching aids, along with functional library, laboratories for core engineering students.'
'Hostel facilities are available for both male and female students with Wi-Fi services and secured environment.'

'There are less clubs in NIT Goa and even the present clubs like E-cell is not active. The recent joined batches have initiated many new clubs but because of less population clubs are not doing very well.'

'Attendance is a big issue here, specially if you are unlucky to get strict professors. Minimum attendance required here is 80% and we have to run to professors requesting them to let us give the exam in the last days of semesters.'

'Companies such as Turtlemint, Findem, Nokia, IFB, Samsung, Adani Power, HDFC Bank, Tesco, Upskill, ONGC, Jio, and many more. Last year almost everyone got placed. Average package is 10 LPA. This year though placements were not as expected because of economic depression. Even after the placements, layoffs have become common.'

'Many companies visit and take campus placements. The average placement for civil engineering is 8-9 lakhs. Highest package was 20 lakhs and 10 out of 100 students get campus placement and others get placement after the college.'

review_items.extraction_note: This review explicitly describes the NEW Cuncolim campus era, giving specific, granular detail about hostel infrastructure quality issues distinctive to a newly-constructed facility.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The campus is new and in hostel one room for one person and the room is really good, we have everything which you need in a room: enough lights, fan, a good cupboard.'
'70 percent of the campus (other than boys hostel) looks nice; they have greenery, a small park-like area in front of girls hostel, and good classrooms; professors are okayish.'

'Many times hostel water tank gets empty, so no water, not even for drinking, for hours, and electricity goes sometimes, not much. One big problem is the internet inside the hostel; outside our hostel network comes, but inside no signal. They have a Wi-Fi which doesn't work well and not much range of it; it's a big problem we face every day.'

review_items.extraction_note: This review explicitly notes the 2023 shift to the new campus, providing a clear before/after framing distinctive to this institution's recent relocation.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Last year and the year before the placements were not that high, but generally a lot of companies visit our college for placements and hire a good number of students. In 2022, the campus placements for CSE, ECE, and EEE were almost 100%. Almost all students got internships but it is generally off-campus.'

'NIT Goa has shifted to the new campus in 2023. So everything is new and it has fresh infrastructure. We have a 2-floor library, one with books and one as a study hall. Lab equipment and classrooms are brand new.'
'I would rate 2.5 out of 5 for the quality of mess food.'

'Medical facilities are great. We have a separate building for it and a 24x7 ambulance near hostels. We have a very big ground for games. We have a basketball ground and a volleyball court. Inside the hostel, we have a badminton court.'

review_items.extraction_note: Batch of 2027. This review explicitly references the college being 'newly built in January 2024,' consistent with the Cuncolim campus era.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Placement scenes in NIT Goa are average. The highest package in NIT Goa is 44 LPA, while the average package is around 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Oracle, TCS, and NSE. 100% of students who appear for placements get placed, while some opt for off-campus placement too.'
'As our college is newly built in January 2024, so infrastructure is top-notch. We have more than enough Wi-Fi routers right in front of our room and in every building.'
'All the teachers are PhD holders from top IITs and NITs so they are great at teaching. The course is carefully designed for each department and is very relevant to the corporate market.'

'If your income is above 1 lac and lower than 5 lacs, then you just have to pay Rs. 22,000 for 1 semester. If your family income is less than 1 lac, then your fee will be less than Rs. 5,000 per semester.'

'The college is in Goa, so it is a lot of fun. A branch is of 40 students only, so teachers pay more attention. We have a robotic club, and you can get a scholarship also. Our college organises a lot of fests.'

review_items.extraction_note: This reviewer explicitly frames their choice of NIT Goa in the context of it being a comparatively newer/lower-ranked NIT, reflecting the institution's distinctive positioning as one of the newer NITs from the 2010 expansion.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The placements were average, but since NIT Goa is one of the newly established NITs, I decided to have a go, as the other colleges where I could have had admissions were poorer than NIT Goa in terms of placements.'
'NIT Goa ranks low; I mean it's in the top 100 engineering colleges of India, but as per my AIEEE rankings, this was the best I could get.'

TWO instances of misattributed/cross-contaminated content were identified and explicitly excluded during this extraction: (1) a GetMyUni review referencing 'mining students,' 'ISM Dhanbad,' and 'Pandit Ravishankar University... University of Chattisgarh' clearly describes a different institution entirely (unrelated to Goa) and was not attributed to NIT Goa; (2) a Collegedunia Q&A page ostensibly about NIT Goa hostels contained content explicitly about IIT Bombay hostel facilities, which was excluded as clearly belonging to a different institution.

This institution underwent a significant physical relocation during the period covered by available reviews (from a temporary Farmagudi/GEC campus to a permanent Cuncolim campus, inaugurated February 2024). Reviews describing 'old' vs 'new' campus conditions are explicitly flagged where identifiable, since blending pre- and post-relocation infrastructure sentiment would be misleading.

NIT Goa and IIT Goa (a separate, newer institute) both operated temporarily from the same Farmagudi location during IIT Goa's early years — a genuine co-location risk during that period that required careful attention during source discovery; no IIT Goa-specific content was included in this extraction.
